part.limitations: Generic enhancement PMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and drain-to-source body diode. Body tied to source; zero gate current. No subthreshold conduction, body effect, gate/junction capacitance, charge storage, switching loss, breakdown, heating, ratings or named device identity. External capacitors provide circuit timing. Same illustrative beta magnitude as the generic NMOS, not a physical matched pair.

capabilities.description: Place a library part on the 10-unit grid; unused optional ID; bounds in snapshot.limits

id.description: Omitted/empty allocates an unused designator; explicit ID cannot have been used earlier in this session, including after delete.

value.description: Omitted/empty uses factory value; net-label uses new ID as name; non-value symbols require omitted/empty value. Supplied numeric values use the per-kind domains; new waveforms use factory offset/low level.

preconditions: A drawing slot is free; explicit ID unused in this session
Finite position within ±10000 units; coordinates snap to nearest 10-unit grid and snapped position must be unoccupied
effects: Commits through ordinary electrical edit/restart/paused-stale and undo rules; invalid input preserves previous graph/physics/history
Selects placed part and returns drawing tool to select; net helpers count toward drawing-object bound, not simulated-part capacity
